title: Witnessed symmetric choice is strictly stronger than choiceless polynomial time with counting
summary: We prove that witnessed symmetric choice strictly increases the expressive power of choiceless polynomial time with counting. A fixed sentence with one witnessed-choice occurrence defines a Boolean query on every finite input that is not definable in the original counting formalism.
family_title: Separating choiceless counting from polynomial time and witnessed choice

review.reason: Shows witnessed symmetric choice strictly extends choiceless polynomial time with counting.
